No blocking introduced defect was found, and the prior generic migration-proof warning is not supported by a changed persistent contract. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `1c6050ff27c6342c8a314aec3c9e4d3bd30a571a` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | A coherent internal cutover with meaningful boundary coverage and no blocking source finding; reported executions were not independently rerun. | | **Proof confidence** | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Not applicable: The maintainer-authored PR is exempt from ordinary contributor proof. Its reported registered task-runtime checks exercise cold valid/invalid configuration through real SQLite after registry readiness; inspected tests support that scope, without establishing live-provider or Windows behavior. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Not applicable | Not applicable: The maintainer-authored PR is exempt from ordinary contributor proof. Its reported registered task-runtime checks exercise cold valid/invalid configuration through real SQLite after registry readiness; inspected tests support that scope, without establishing live-provider or Windows behavior. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 10 items | Current main still needs this cutover: Current main calls synchronous canOwnerAccessTask after worker reads; that owner resolves bare session identities through getRuntimeConfig. The supplied merged metadata prerequisite explicitly leaves configuration preparation as separate work.
Publication and visibility safeguards: Task visibility awaits the existing identity rules and rechecks database admission before returning records. Cold configuration publication checks source selectors, snapshot generation, preparer generation, candidate facts, and staged environment; superseded environment publication rolls back.
Persistent contracts remain unchanged: The new worker selector reads the existing plugins.bundledDiscovery row, and the Claw reader selects existing consent columns through the artifact-preserving reader with an ownership check. No DDL, persisted encoding, retention rule, or schema-version change is introduced. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together Plugins query background tasks through OpenClaw’s task runtime. It reads persisted records, resolves the requesting owner’s identity, and returns only visible task details; cold configuration preparation supplies missing identity and policy facts. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Plugin task query] --> B[Read persisted tasks] B --> C{Owner identity available?} C -->|Yes| E[Check owner visibility] C -->|No| D[Await configuration preparation] F[Environment and stored plugin consent facts] --> D D --> E E --> G[Return visible task details] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add data-model compatibility proof** - Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge.

### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Production versus test growth** | Production +1,192 net lines; tests/support +1,502 net lines | The PR justifies production growth through awaited preparation and shared validation, with substantial boundary and publication coverage. | ### Stored data model Persistent data-model change detected: `database schema: src/claws/provenance-runtime-read.kernel.ts`, `database schema: src/claws/provenance-runtime-read.ts`. Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge. ### Root-cause cluster Relationship: `partial_overlap` Canonical: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/144592 Summary: This PR handles configuration preparation within the broader asynchronous-storage effort; registry restoration remains separate. Members: - `canonical`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/144592 - The open umbrella explicitly tracks asynchronous store owners and their actual callers. - `adjacent_distinct`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/148017 - The merged prerequisite moves installed metadata reads to the worker and explicitly excludes broader configuration preparation. Proposal only: this assessment does not dispatch repair, suppress jobs, mutate sibling items, close, or merge anything. ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep configuration preparation behind the existing publication and metadata owners, preserving task visibility and synchronous compatibility while moving cold SQLite reads off the Gateway thread. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes, from source: a bare-owner task without a persisted requester agent reaches the synchronous configuration loader on current main. The registered SQLite test provides a focused measurement path; this review did not execute it. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes. Shared sync/async orchestration retains one validation policy and existing storage owners, while the added preparation path addresses the identified cold-read boundary. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Cold configuration publication checks source selectors, snapshot generation, preparer generation, candidate facts, and staged environment; superseded environment publication rolls back. ([`src/config/runtime-snapshot.ts:519`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1c6050ff27c6342c8a314aec3c9e4d3bd30a571a/src/config/runtime-snapshot.ts#L519), [1c6050ff27c6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c6050ff27c6342c8a314aec3c9e4d3bd30a571a)) - **Persistent contracts remain unchanged:** The new worker selector reads the existing plugins.bundledDiscovery row, and the Claw reader selects existing consent columns through the artifact-preserving reader with an ownership check. No DDL, persisted encoding, retention rule, or schema-version change is introduced. ([`src/state/openclaw-state.worker.ts:145`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1c6050ff27c6342c8a314aec3c9e4d3bd30a571a/src/state/openclaw-state.worker.ts#L145), [1c6050ff27c6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c6050ff27c6342c8a314aec3c9e4d3bd30a571a)) - **Prior review warning reassessed:** The prior completed review had no findings and requested generic migration or upgrade compatibility proof. The storage policy exempts semantics-preserving reads from its material-change checkpoint; inspected tests cover fresh defaults, existing metadata, environment ownership, and superseded recovery observations. No schema migration requirement was established. Public docs: [`docs/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes.md`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes). ([`docs/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes.md:412`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes), [1c6050ff27c6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c6050ff27c6342c8a314aec3c9e4d3bd30a571a)) - **Registered task boundary coverage:** The added valid/invalid bare-owner cases invoke createPluginRuntime().tasks.async across get, list, findLatest, and resolve against SQLite fixtures. They assert returned visibility, snapshot publication, and zero parent-thread SQLite calls after registry readiness. These tests were inspected, not executed during this review. ([`src/infra/sqlite-worker-task-runtime.test.ts:105`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1c6050ff27c6342c8a314aec3c9e4d3bd30a571a/src/infra/sqlite-worker-task-runtime.test.ts#L105), [1c6050ff27c6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c6050ff27c6342c8a314aec3c9e4d3bd30a571a)) - **Captured validation evidence:** The supplied complete PR body reports 17 ordinary controls, an inherited schema control, 75 routing checks, the selected check gate, and a full build on tree 0b0ed30e91819da01727e110362b1aa4fd63ab17. Local tree identity matches. The body expressly excludes Windows, live-provider, and several native fault scenarios; those were not treated as exercised.
